notes.title: BUGS CORRIGIDOS E MUDANÇAS FEITAS
notes.content:
With feedback from the community we were able to find many previously unknown bugs, in addition to improving aspects of the game itself based on the suggestions received.

List of fixed bugs:

- General item crafting button that was stopping working or getting slow when crafting multiple items at once
- Some bosses not dying after reaching 0 health
- Items from chests disappearing
- Chest slots stopping working

In addition to the fixes, we have also implemented significant changes to the game:

- Some players reported problems with the invasion system, some monsters could destroy parts of your house, as it is a mechanic that displeased most players, we decided to change it, now the enemies no longer break your buildings and only focus on attacking the player .
- Items that are built with electronic circuits are cheaper

Finally, we are aware of some players' interest in playing Doomed Lands on the Steam Deck. Although we do not yet have definitive information about the game's compatibility with this platform, we are dedicating efforts to investigating this possibility. Stay tuned for more updates soon.

We greatly appreciate the community's continued support and look forward to continuing to improve the gameplay experience for all Doomed Lands players.

notes.title: BUGS CORRIGIDOS #3
notes.content:
Lista de bugs consertados:

- Jogabilidade aprimorada do gamepad dentro de casa.
- Corrigido bug relacionado a paredes se tornando de outros materiais.
- Agora você pode destruir as armadilhas usando a picareta também.
- Balanceamento do chefe alienígena (mais HP).
- Adicionado mais opções de controle, agora pode plantar, comer e colocar estruturas com RB usando um gamepad.

Se você tiver algum problema de bug, basta escrever para a comunidade Steam na postagem fixada ou em nosso discord.

notes.title: Dev Update #3 - Combat
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’ve been working really hard on Doomed Lands, and we’re really excited to show off some things we’ve been working on so far.

We haven’t gotten the opportunity to show off some combat yet, so here we are - THE COMBAT UPDATE.

Here’s what an enemy camps might look like!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374343/0b755c9dab6e9feff65db42c0cb46cedf394dba7.gif[/img]

Of course, different enemies might have different camps, like this one:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374343/e68b20d4c787bcc5ae378107fb3f5177f4e216b0.gif[/img]

Not only do we have enemy camps, but we do have the ability to trap enemies!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374343/a8ad3c58a9b571a62fd3c3e0cfb3c613864be872.gif[/img]

 A new enemy appears! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374343/1717f68defa9c41ad80ed3676a65d70254e52aed.gif[/img]

While we’re here, we’re taking the opportunity to show several different skins that we added recently. Here’s one last one!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374343/0b920f0f3bb00689bb236b8677eebc6894b30fca.gif[/img]

If you like what you see, don’t forget to wishlist us on Steam!
Thank you everyone for your support as we make our game. We couldn’t do it without you! Don’t forget to join our [url=https://discord.gg/p9exbCsU9t]Discord[/url] and follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/NibbGames]Twitter[/url] for more Doomed Land updates.

See you next time!
The dev team

notes.title: Dev Update #2
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’ve been working really hard on Doomed Lands, and we’re really excited to show off some things we’ve been working on so far.

We’ve implemented cooking and recipes. Here’s a look at a couple recipes in our cooking pot:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374343/ca33360d84cfa442fc69b72a6a8aa362024d0932.gif[/img]

Different recipes call for different ingredients. These recipes will provide certain buffs and HP! What recipe do you see that you’re most excited about? Feel free to let us know in the comments!

We’ve also added a farm animal 🐮
In addition to growing produce on your farm, farm animals will be another important source of ingredients for recipes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374343/9c56bec0081eeee486ae97101b78448ad8a07b8c.gif[/img]

If you like what you see, don’t forget to wishlist us on Steam!
Thank you everyone for your support as we make our game. We couldn’t do it without you!

See you next time!
The dev team

notes.title: Dev Update #1
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’ve been working really hard on Doomed Lands, and we’re really excited to show off some things we’ve been working on so far.

We’ve implemented a way to skip to the next day in order for you to pass the time as you choose. By sleeping in your bed, you can move onward to the next day!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374343/43f66390a28db701085d73ba266fba53c7eafa00.gif[/img]

The passage of time is very important since you only have 7 days before a new boss comes!

Here, you can see the altar. The altar allows you to summon certain monsters, such as the slime you can see below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374343/84284bfe8f40b4b4f04c969de5492fc57ffe50a3.gif[/img]

Remember when we mentioned bosses?
Right.
Well, here’s a sneak peek at one of them - and some spells you can use to defeat them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374343/66b7a6fa534846c3f4959d3c021b6eff676d53b1.gif[/img]

And finally, even heroes need to eat sometimes. You can farm and grow your own food just like this!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40374343/85a459e2d4cd7319cba76d1283331623496dd302.gif[/img]

Mmmmm! Fresh produce is sure to help boost your HP 😉

If you like what you see, don’t forget to wishlist us on Steam!
Thank you everyone for your support as we make our game. We couldn’t do it without you! 

See you next time!
